👋 Hi! I'm your learning assistant.
• Send /learn <url> to save and summarize an article.
• Send /quiz to test yourself on a saved material.
• Send /start to see this again.

assignments.name: prompt
assignments.value:
=The previous response did not match the required JSON schema. You MUST return ONLY a single valid JSON object — no prose, no explanations, no code fences, no extra fields.

Schema (exact):
{
  "title": string (non-empty, max 120 chars),
  "mainConcepts": array of 3 to 5 non-empty strings,
  "keyPoints": array of 5 to 7 non-empty strings,
  "difficulty": one of "beginner" | "intermediate" | "advanced"
}

Return only that JSON object. Now summarise the content below.

--- BEGIN CONTENT ---
{{ $json._learn.extractedContent }}
--- END CONTENT ---

assignments.name: prompt
assignments.value:
=You are the Teacher AI. Read the extracted page content below and produce a JSON object summarising it.

Your response MUST be ONLY a single valid JSON object matching this schema exactly. Do not include any text outside the JSON. Do not wrap it in markdown code fences.

Schema:
{
  "title": string (inferred from the content, max 120 chars),
  "mainConcepts": string[] of 3 to 5 short noun-phrase keywords,
  "keyPoints": string[] of 5 to 7 one-sentence bullets,
  "difficulty": one of "beginner" | "intermediate" | "advanced"
}

Return only the json object.

--- BEGIN CONTENT ---
{{ $json._learn.extractedContent }}
--- END CONTENT ---
